data.promptProse: Jogging along a winding coastal path in the early morning, Bazett holds a steady pace against the scenic backdrop of the rocky Irish shoreline. Golden sunrise light breaks across the horizon and sea, highlighting the morning landscape.
data.animaCaption: Jogging at a steady, athletic pace along a winding coastal trail above the rocky sea, she keeps her gaze forward in quiet focus. Golden sunrise light breaks over the horizon and brightens the ocean waves beside her.
